description: Reads a single dispute by its ID (equals the exchangeId). Read-only. Returns: dispute entity with state, timeout, buyerPercent. Use get_disputes to search first.

configId.description: Boson/Fermion Protocol deployment identifier. Format: '<env>-<chainId>-<index>' e.g. 'production-137-0' (Polygon mainnet), 'testing-80002-0' (Amoy testnet). Call get_config_ids to list all valid values for this server.

disputeId.description: Numeric ID of the dispute to retrieve. Note: disputeId equals the exchangeId of the associated exchange.

queryVars.description: Optional additional subgraph query variables for field selection. Leave empty for default fields.

name: get_dispute_by_id
